purpose: Teach: 沈ん/終っ/有っ/盗ん/図ら/造ら/生かさ/臨ん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが疲れて椅子に沈んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad looked exhausted, just sinking into his chair.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not urgency. Noticing something tender about someone she cares about. Warm, a little concerned underneath. Speaking as if to herself first.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、宿題が終ったよ
lines.style: Bright burst of pride. Quick, eager. A six-year-old announcing something he worked for. Not asking permission — offering good news. Small, genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが有ってこそ家族が安心ね
lines.en: Sho, it's because your dad is here that we all feel safe.
lines.style: Tender insight. Slow, deliberate. She's saying something true and wants him to hear it. Quiet conviction, not lecturing. A hand on his shoulder in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絶対物を盗んだりしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I would never steal anything.
lines.style: Serious and certain. He's not defensive — he's stating something important to him. Direct eye contact in his voice. A small boy being very sincere about his own integrity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんの将来を図らって下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is thinking about your future and helping you along the way.
lines.style: Reflective warmth. Slower pace. She's connecting something she's noticed to something deeper. Not telling him what to think — letting him land on it himself. Gentle teaching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが秘密基地を造らせて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad let me build a secret base!
lines.style: Unbridled joy. Quick tempo, bright attack on the opening. A six-year-old reliving something magical. Wonder in every word. Not bragging — sharing treasure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの教えを生かさないとね
lines.en: Sho, you have to take what your dad taught you and put it to use.
lines.style: Gentle guidance. Not commanding — offering wisdom. The tone of someone passing something down without heaviness. A slight rise at the end, like she's opening a door for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会に臨んで一等取ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I came in first place at the sports day!
lines.style: Glowing pride. Bright and clear, a little breathless with excitement. He's been holding this in, waiting to tell her. Simple, honest joy. The happiest version of his small voice.
